Where the window gets 225 from is not known (Tim's Settings file holds pipe.diameter 100); the case is therefore tied to what the window shows on this PC. The label's Above side is checked as "insertion point above the pipe line (y greater than -80000)"; that it reads left to right is still a Codex look.
